purpose: Compose one reusable business-partner workspace for customer, supplier, or farmer context without embedding domain scoring logic.

useWhen: users need one relationship view across current work, signals, activity, and history
customer, supplier, or farmer data shares the same structural anatomy
avoidWhen: the task is only a small contact card
the consumer expects Ten4Seven to calculate business reliability or scoring

responsive.desktop: Use summary, current work, and activity or detail in a clear multi-region composition.
responsive.tablet: Keep the entity summary first and collapse secondary history below current work.
responsive.mobile: Order summary, current work, signals, activity, then history.

accessibility: Use one entity heading and named sections for current work, signals, activity, and history.
Keep tables and timelines in logical reading order.
Provide text for relationship health and exceptions.
operational.aiGuidance: Choose Entity 360 for shared customer, supplier, or farmer context; keep scoring and business rules consumer-owned.
antiPatterns: Creating structurally unrelated customer, supplier, and farmer shells
Embedding opaque business scores in the design system
Replacing current work with a profile-only card
